_what_this_is: The dated, sha-pinned disposition ledger for every commit that had ALREADY landed with a real
`Measured-effect:` trailer at the moment strict registration was switched on. It exists for the
same reason `native-grandfather.json` exists: turning a fail-closed gate on over an estate that
predates it has exactly two honest options, and this is the second one.
Option one - fail `validate` on all 24 rows - bricks `protected-win validate`, and therefore
`check` and `bump`, on day one. A gate nobody can pass is a gate somebody switches off.
Option two - file the real wins under a soft reason so the gate goes quiet - is the DISCARD the
President's mandate forbids, and it is worse than no gate at all because it looks like custody.
So: every pre-existing row is recorded ONCE, with a written disposition, and strict registration
bites on everything landed AFTER this baseline. Rows marked REGISTRATION OWED are REAL WINS that
are not yet fully describable (protected paths, anchors, quality gate and workload must all be
honestly known before an entry may be written). They are not dismissed and they are not closed -
they stay here, visible, until their manifest entry can be written truthfully. A win is a win.
This ledger is CLOSED to new shas by convention. A newly landed measured win must be REGISTERED
in protected-wins.json, not added here. `protected-win discover --all` prints every row below
with its disposition, so the ledger cannot rot unseen.

_disposition_vocabulary.REGISTRATION OWED: a real, landed win; its manifest entry is owed and cannot yet be written without inventing a field
_disposition_vocabulary.NOT A MECHANISM: the commit records a measurement, a bench, a negative result or generated artifacts - there is no mechanism of ours for an upstream change to overwrite
_disposition_vocabulary.NO RUNTIME EFFECT: the commit's own trailer states it changes no engine behaviour and moves no shipped default
_disposition_vocabulary.CORRECTNESS ONLY, SPEED UNMEASURED: the commit's own trailer declines to make a speed claim
_disposition_vocabulary.NOT LANDED AS A WORKING WIN: the change is blocked or inert on this seat by its own trailer
